This article shall apply to buildings with exhaust ducts under positive pressure, chimneys, and vents that extend into or pass through ducts or plenums.
(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
